title: Study on the deposition behavior of sodium/sulfide elements during the operation of radiant syngas cooler in an entrained-flow gasifier
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21731-21741
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02794B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chunlei Gao, Linmin Zhang, Xudong Song, JinSheng Cao, Qinghua Guo, Guangsuo Yu
This study systematically samples the ash slag in key areas of the radiant syngas cooler in the entrained-flow gasifier and explores the ash slag deposition mechanism in different spatial areas.
